paragraphs.text: On the coast of Brittany, salt is still made by hand in shallow clay pools. Seawater flows into the pools at high tide, and the sun and wind slowly evaporate it. Workers rake the fine salt crystals that form on the surface, a delicate product known as fleur de sel, which sells for far more than ordinary salt.
paragraphs.label: A
